definitions.gloss: muddy, covered in mud, mud-covered state
definitions.explanation: The state of being covered in mud, or mud itself (in childish speech). Very common in contexts involving children playing outside.

examples.japanese: どろんこ{遊|あそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どろんこになって⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing and getting all muddy.

notes:
どろんこ describes the state of being covered in mud, or mud itself in a playful, childish sense. It has a warm, nostalgic quality associated with children playing outdoors.

FORMS:
⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧ (mud) + んこ (emphatic/childish suffix). Can also be written as {泥|どろ}んこ.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どろんこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get all muddy
- どろんこ{遊|あそ}び: mud play (a common childhood activity)
- どろんこ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: muddy road
- どろんこ⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧: covered in mud everywhere

REGISTER:
Informal, with a childish or affectionate quality. Adults might use it nostalgically or when talking to/about children. For neutral descriptions, use ⟦{泥|どろ}だらけ→泥だらけ：15076_dorodarake⟧ (muddy, covered in mud) instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧: mud (neutral)
- ⟦{泥|どろ}だらけ→泥だらけ：15076_dorodarake⟧: covered in mud (neutral/descriptive)
- ⟦ぬかるみ→ぬかるみ：16209_nukarumi⟧: muddy ground, quagmire
